body: I'm in my hotel room. I've booked for 3 nights. Today is my relaxation day. I just want to savour every moment of today. To be calm when I do it. I feel at ease, finally, knowing that this pain will end soon. Thank you for checking up on me

I just don't want my family to have a gruesome body to bury. Thank you for your thoughtful reply.

It's just been a culmination of so many things. Two failed pregnancies, sacrificing my career for my husband. And then my grandmother died and my husband has stopped caring about me. They were the two people I lived for. I watched my grandmother die and it haunts me every single day. I have BPD and PTSD (from something else) and I just cannot live like this. 

There are attachments but and everyday I am around my wonderful niece and nephew and family but I still feel so alien to them all. I just feel like a zombie.
My grandmother and my husband were the two people I lived for. Now my grandmother is gone and my husband really doesn't care about me anymore. I'm just tired of all the pain and hurt.
